item.title: Webworm Suspected of Modifying SoftEther VPN to Evade Detection and Hide Remote Access
item.description: Report that the Webworm group modified SoftEther VPN to hide remote access and evade detection: legitimate tunneling software repurposed as a stealthy backdoor.

item.title: Nightdive's Thief remaster will make the most "infamous" Thief Gold level a little less maddening, by "just kind of pointing the player in the right direction"
item.description: Nightdive's Thief remaster quietly adds guidance to the most notorious Thief Gold level, a look at how remasters revise level design.

item.title: Nvidia release hotfix for latest graphics card driver battering SSDs with excessive writes, but it looks like reverting may still be the better option
item.description: Nvidia's latest GPU driver was causing excessive SSD writes. The hotfix may not fully cure it, so rolling back is still the safer option.

item.title: The Incredible, Elegant DNA Repair System Makes Gene Editing Work
item.description: Explainer on the DNA repair mechanism that gene editing depends on, and why editing outcomes hinge on how cells fix breaks.

item.title: Freeing the iPod Nano 5G
item.description: Write-up on unlocking the iPod Nano 5G, freeing old hardware to run code its maker never allowed.

item.title: Building a wireless network adapter for the Super Nintendo
item.description: A home-built wireless network adapter for the Super Nintendo, connecting a 1990s console to modern networks.

item.title: Nospeaker ─ Make your MacBook's trackpad talk using its haptic motor
item.description: Open-source tool that makes the MacBook trackpad's haptic motor play audio. A clever reuse of the hardware.
